FreeFlow

Showing sample data (synthetic). Opening your own files replaces it.

Analyse flow cytometry data in your browser

Open FCS files to gate, compensate and build figures. Your files stay on your computer: nothing is uploaded.

You can also drop files or a folder anywhere on this page.

Samples

    Drag gates onto any population in any sample to copy them there. Drop on a sample's name to copy them to the same place in its tree.

    Populations

      Ctrl/⌘-click or Shift-click to select several gates, then drag them together. Esc clears the selection.

      Statistics

      Samples

        Click a population to add its plot to the page, or drag it to where you want it.

            Analysis bundle

            One .zip with the original FCS files, the gates, axis settings, compensation and layouts. Send it to someone and they continue where you left off: they open the .zip in FreeFlow (Open FCS files), or unzip it and open the .wsp workspace in other analysis software.

            Workspace file (.wsp)

            Just the gates, axis settings and compensation as a .wsp workspace, for when the other person already has the FCS files. Uses the name above.
